systems.system: Direct, real-time, remote electronic access by the Director-General of the Mauritius Revenue Authority to the civil status database (a member cites it as newly inserted subsection 123G)

note: A member's speech of 2026-07-31 objecting to the revenue authority's access to the civil status database and to the Civil Status Act amendment on marriages to non-citizens; nothing on how or where births and deaths are recorded.
